jobs.title: Director Marketing Technology Analytics & Digital Platforms
jobs.description:
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we help people, businesses, and society prosper in good times and be resilient in bad times.

Our employee promise represents Intact’s commitment to you in exchange for living our Values, striving to do your best work, being open to change and investing in your career. In return, we promise to provide support, opportunities and performance-led financial rewards at a workplace where you can shape the future, win as a team and grow with us.

Pay at Intact is about much more than just salary.

Flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work model
Possibility to purchase up to 5 extra days off per year
Multiple benefits offered to support physical and mental wellbeing, including telemedicine, Wellness account and much more
Share plan & other savings: up to 12% of salary or even more (ask how you could earn guaranteed income for life)

Salary Range (but Not Limited To)

161,600 - 197,500

Annual Bonus Target, Based On The Base Salary, With a Potential Payout Of Up To Double The Target (subject To Personal And Company Performance)

20%

As part of our commitment to Win As A Team
, we share our success with employees through our annual bonus plan and Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) – with Intact matching 50% of your net shares.

Our pension offerings provide flexibility and long-term security for our employees beyond their careers. We are one of the few companies offering the opportunity to receive guaranteed income for life via our defined benefit pension plan.

Salary for the candidate will be determined taking into consideration a number of factors including: experience, skills, qualifications, anticipated contribution to role, internal equity, etc. The salary range presented above is based on a 35-hour workweek and would represent a majority of different candidate profiles. However, we encourage candidates who may fall outside of this range to apply as well.

About The Role

At Intact, we believe innovation and customer experience are at the heart of everything we do. With a commitment to excellence, we push the boundaries of digital marketing to deliver smart, customer-focused solutions. We’re looking for a visionary leader to spearhead our marketing technology, digital platforms and marketing analytics strategy while enhancing our capabilities in an ever-evolving environment.

Role Overview

As the Director, Marketing Technology, Analytics and Digital Platforms,
you will lead the development and implementation of Intact’s MarTech, Digital Platforms and Marketing Analytics strategy. You will oversee the management of our technology platforms while collaborating with marketing, IT, and analytics teams to create integrated solutions that maximize campaign efficiency and impact. Your role will be critical in accelerating our digital transformation and personalizing the customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

MarTech Strategy

Develop and execute a forward-thinking MarTech vision aligned with Intact’s strategic goals.
Assess and recommend emerging technologies to enhance customer engagement, automation, and marketing outcomes.
Maintain a prioritized roadmap focused on business value, customer impact, and operational efficiency.

Platform Management

Oversee core MarTech capabilities, including CMS, CMP, customer data, marketing automation, personalization, digital experience, and measurement.
Ensure platforms are integrated, scalable, secure, and effectively adopted.
Manage technology partners, platform performance, and investment optimization.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with marketing, IT, and data teams to define and execute aligned solutions.
Act as a strategic liaison between technical and marketing teams.
Act as the strategic bridge between marketing, IT, data, analytics, business teams, and external partners.
Enable teams through clear processes, standards, training, and change management.

Data, Governance, And Measurement

Partner with data, privacy, security, and analytics teams to promote responsible use of customer data.
Strengthen governance for consent, identity, data quality, and audience activation.
Measure the effectiveness of MarTech solutions and provide data-driven recommendations.
Identify opportunities for optimization and growth in technology investments.
Lead the marketing analytics team and roadmap.

Team Leadership

Build and manage a team of MarTech experts.
Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and results-driven thinking.

What You Bring To The Table

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, information technology, or a related field (MBA is an asset).
Minimum of 10 years of experience in digital marketing and/or technology, with at least 5 years in a MarTech leadership role.
Proven expertise in modern MarTech ecosystems such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe CJA/Analytics, etc.
Strong understanding of customer data, automation, and personalization concepts.
Excellent leadership skills with the ability to drive complex projects.
Proficiency in interpreting data to guide strategic decision-making.
For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English-speaking colleagues across the country.
No Canadian work experience required however must be eligible to work in Canada.

We are an equal opportunity employer

At Intact, our Value of respect is founded on seeing diversity as a strength. We strive to create an accessible workplace where employees feel valued, included and encouraged to share their unique perspectives.

We encourage applications from individuals who are members of equity-deserving groups, including but not limited to women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, Black people, and members of the 2SLGBTQI+ community.

As part of Intact’s commitment to reconciliation, we acknowledge that we work, meet and travel across the land currently called Canada, originally inhabited by First Nations, Metis and Inuit people. This history extends through many centuries and continues to evolve today.

We have policies to ensure equal access and participation for people with disabilities, including providing workplace adjustments (accommodations). A copy of applicable policies is available on request.

If we can provide a specific adjustment to make the recruitment process more accessible for you, please let us know when we reach out about a job opportunity. We’ll work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our recruitment process and your candidate journey here.

Please note that Intact does not provide sponsorship or other support for immigration-related matters including but not limited to employer-specific closed work permits. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada from the anticipated start date and throughout their employment and are solely responsible for maintaining their work eligibility.

jobs.title: Director, Quantitative Data Products
jobs.description:
Director, Quantitative Data Products

Nasdaq's Alternative Data group specializes in creating unique and insightful data products from non-traditional data sources. Well-known examples of Alternative Data include sentiment measures, real-time tracking of vehicles via GPS transponders, satellite monitoring of industrial facilities, and consumer insights gleaned from anonymized credit card transactions. Our data products empower some of the world's most sophisticated investment funds to outperform.

As Director of Quantitative Data Products, you'll play a critical role in defining strategy and driving execution of a portfolio of innovative Alternative Data products. You'll thrive in this position if you're entrepreneurial, data-driven, and strategic, with a deep understanding of investments and a passion for creating products that generate real business impact in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate has trade floor and/or investments experience, with a strong understanding of buy-side and sell-side trading workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct market research and engage directly with clients to identify new product opportunities and validate concepts.
Own the full product lifecycle from ideation and validation through launch, scale, and ongoing optimization.
Develop and prioritize product roadmaps that align with business objectives and drive measurable revenue growth.
Partner with cross-functional teams including data science, data engineering, partnerships, client success, sales, and marketing to design and deliver innovative data products.
Drive go-to-market strategy, including pricing, positioning, and sales enablement to maximize product adoption and success.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in product management, product development, and/or data analysis within the investment industry.
Deep understanding of capital markets, data product fundamentals, and data feeds/products.
Proven ability to conceptualize and drive new initiatives from 0-to-1 in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and a revenue-focused, owner mindset.
Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong understanding of the alternative data landscape, including key companies and products/services, as well as their competitive positioning.
Experienced in evaluating and applying alternative data to the investment lifecycle (i.e., programming, statistics, backtesting, etc).
0-to-1 startup or venture-building experience.

This position will be located in Toronto and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.

Come as You Are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

What We Offer

We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package that is meaningful, recognizes the unique needs of our employees and their families and incentivizes employees for their contribution to Nasdaq’s overall success.

The base pay range for this role is $121,000 - $170,000. In addition to base salary, Nasdaq provides a generous annual bonus/commission (short-term incentive), and equity (long-term incentive), comprehensive benefits, and opportunity for growth. Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, business needs and market demands.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Technology Architecture & Governance
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.

The Role

The Managing Director, Technology Architecture & Governance is accountable for setting and governing CPP Investments’ enterprise technology architecture, As Managing Director, Technology Architecture & Governance, you will set and govern CPP Investments’ enterprise technology architecture, engineering practices and lifecycle standards, helping ensure the Fund operates on a resilient, modern and sustainable technology foundation.

Reporting to the Managing Director, Head of Technology & Data, you will provide practical, outcome-focused direction on architecture, technical debt, technology lifecycle management and engineering excellence. This enterprise leadership role has no direct reports and operates through influence, deep technical expertise, sound judgement and effective governance.

The Team

Technology & Data helps enable CPP Investments’ investment strategies and supports the Fund’s day-to-day operations through enterprise technology and data capabilities. Within the department, the Technology Architecture & Governance mandate provides enterprise-wide direction for architecture, engineering practices and technology lifecycle management, partnering across the Fund to strengthen resilience, scalability, cost efficiency and delivery effectiveness.

Accountabilities

Define and maintain the enterprise technology architecture, capability model and capability roadmap aligned to CPP Investments’ mandate, One Fund strategy, and long-term business objectives.
Provide clear architectural direction that balances innovation, resilience, security, and cost efficiency across the enterprise.
Lead lightweight, decision-oriented architecture governance focused on unblocking teams and resolving trade-offs, rather than enforcing rigid controls.
Provide timely, well-reasoned guidance on complex design choices, ensuring alignment across platforms while enabling local autonomy where appropriate.
Act as a senior problem solver for the enterprise, engaging directly in the most complex, ambiguous, and high-impact business problems and technology challenges.
Bring systems thinking and deep technical judgement to diagnose root causes, shape options, and guide decisions that balance near-term outcomes with long-term sustainability.
Own the enterprise approach to technology lifecycle management, including currency, obsolescence, and vendor dependency risk.
Define strategies to identify, prioritize, and systematically reduce technical debt, improving platform stability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership over time.
Set enterprise expectations for software development lifecycle, engineering excellence, and ways of working including agile practices.
Drive continuous improvement in how technology is designed, built, tested, and released, enabling predictable delivery, higher quality outcomes, and faster time to value

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required
Advanced education or professional certifications in architecture, cloud, or engineering practices considered an asset
Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in technology architecture, engineering leadership, or enterprise technology roles
Demonstrated success leading large-scale technology decisions and standards in complex organizations
Experience in financial services, investment management, or other complex enterprises is preferred
Deep expertise in engineering, enterprise architecture, modern technology platforms, and large-scale system design
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, integration patterns, modern data achitecture, and security principles
Proven experience establishing and governing software development lifecycle, engineering standards, and agile practices
Expertise in technology lifecycle management, vendor strategy, and technical debt remediation
Understanding of financial services or large, complex enterprises and their regulatory and risk environments

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.

We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

Inclusion & Accessibility

CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud

CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.

CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

jobs.title: Vice President (Head) of Finance
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected, mission-driven not-for-profit organization dedicated to improving well-being and quality of life in the communities it serves. The organization is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Vice President, Finance to join its Executive Leadership Team. Reporting to the CEO, the Vice President will provide enterprise-wide leadership across Finance and corporate services, while serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and senior leadership team.

The organization delivers essential services to a large and diverse client base. Behind every service are countless financial, operational, and strategic decisions that turn resources into meaningful impact. As Vice President, Finance, the successful candidate will ensure the financial strength, insight, and discipline needed to advance the mission and support long-term sustainability.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an accomplished finance executive who combines strategic insight with operational leadership and wants to influence meaningful outcomes in a purpose-driven organization. More than a functional leader, the Vice President will be a key enterprise partner, helping shape strategy, support growth, and position the organization for continued success in a complex operating environment.

The Mandate

The mandate extends well beyond traditional financial stewardship. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the VP will help shape organizational strategy, support evidence-based decision-making, and ensure the long-term sustainability of an organization delivering critical services.

In partnership with the CEO, Board, and senior leadership team, the VP will provide strategic financial leadership across planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, treasury, audit, risk management, and compliance. They will ensure financial resources are aligned with organizational priorities while maintaining the discipline and accountability the mission requires.

A key priority will be supporting the organization through a period of growth and change. Using financial insights and performance data, the VP will help evaluate opportunities, inform strategic initiatives, and optimize the deployment of resources in a complex funding and operating environment. Success will require balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and sound financial management.

Beyond finance, the VP will provide executive oversight of key corporate services, including procurement and facilities, ensuring effective stewardship of organizational resources and infrastructure. The role will also lead efforts to strengthen internal capabilities, foster collaboration across departments, and build a high-performing, engaged team.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to evolve the finance function from a trusted service provider into an even more proactive strategic partner and to enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. Success will be measured not only by financial outcomes, but also by the ability to influence strategy, support growth, and contribute to long-term sustainability and impact.

Leadership and Stewardship

The organization is seeking a VP Finance who leads with maturity and earns trust through action. This is not a role for someone who relies on title or tenure to get things done. The culture here rewards people who show up prepared, communicate clearly, and follow through.
Operates with humility, credibility, and sound judgment
Brings a practical, solutions-oriented mindset
Communicates clearly and influences at all levels
A good partner to the program managers – asking what they need before explaining what the number say
Leads with integrity, accountability, and transparency

Ideal Background

The successful candidate will bring experience in social services, healthcare, the boarder public sector, or the not-for-profit sector. Those who understand the operational, funding, and stakeholder dynamics of publicly funded organizations will be particular well positioned for success.
A CPA designation and progressive senior finance leadership experience.
Experience leading finance within a complex, multi-stakeholder organization.
A strong understanding of financial planning, financial reporting, treasury, governance, risk management, and internal controls.
Experience working with Boards and senior executives in a strategic advisory capacity.
The ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
A collaborative leadership style and a reputation for building strong relationships across an organization.

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to combine executive-level impact with genuine purpose. As a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Vice President, Finance will help shape decisions that influence the organization’s direction, sustainability, and growth.

The successful candidate will join an organization at an exciting point in its journey, with the opportunity to strengthen financial stewardship, support strategic priorities, and help position the organization for continued success. The organization measures its success not only by financial performance, but by the positive impact it has on the people and communities it serves.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of a mission-driven organization, we encourage you to apply in confidence.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer
Or a VP Engineering who wants to take the next big step

Our client is a growing software company of 20+ people serving the skilled trades and union sector through a portfolio of specialized technology products.

Their business includes three major products:

1. Member Management SaaS Platform

A SaaS product designed for skilled trades unions to manage members, dues, dispatch, communications, reporting, and administrative workflows.

2. Trade School SaaS Platform

A SaaS product focused on apprenticeship and trade school administration, including student records, class scheduling, curriculum tracking, attendance, evaluations, and compliance-related reporting.

3. XR Training and Simulation Platform

An advanced XR development platform that uses virtual reality, mixed reality, motion capture, volumetric video, and agentic AI to create highly detailed, customized training scenarios for the skilled trades. This platform supports immersive, scenario-based learning that can simulate complex work environments, safety procedures, field conditions, and hands-on technical instruction.

Our client’s customers rely on them for dependable systems that support critical operational workflows, member services, education, and training. As they continue to scale, they are looking for a senior technology leader who can bring strategic direction, operational discipline, technical depth, and practical AI leadership to their engineering organization.

Role Summary

We are seeking a CTO / VP Engineering to lead our technology organization through its next stage of growth.

This is a hybrid executive and operational leadership role. The ideal candidate can contribute to company strategy at the leadership table while also driving execution across engineering, architecture, platform reliability, security, AI governance, and product delivery.

This person will be responsible for ensuring that our technology organization is scalable, accountable, secure, and aligned with business priorities. They will help shape the technical vision for our SaaS platforms and XR/AI products while improving delivery predictability, team structure, engineering practices, and long-term product quality.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a mid-sized company where leadership requires both strategic thinking and hands-on operational involvement. They should be able to move fluidly between product strategy, engineering management, customer impact, architecture decisions, AI governance, and team coaching.

Key Responsibilities

Own and evolve the overall technology strategy across the company’s SaaS and XR/AI product portfolio.
Lead the engineering organization, including software development, architecture, infrastructure, DevOps, QA, technical support escalation, and AI-related engineering practices.
Partner with the CEO, product leadership, customer success, sales, and operations to align technology decisions with business goals.
Establish clear engineering priorities, delivery processes, accountability structures, and performance expectations.
Improve predictability of product delivery through better planning, estimation, roadmap execution, release management, and communication.
Balance new product development, customer-specific needs, technical debt, security, scalability, and platform reliability.
Provide technical leadership for multi-tenant SaaS architecture, integrations, data management, reporting, automation, and platform modernization.
Guide the continued development of agentic AI features and immersive XR training capabilities.
Oversee engineering budgets, tooling decisions, vendor relationships, infrastructure costs, and AI-related cost controls.
Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering team.
Define and track engineering performance metrics.
Ensure the company maintains appropriate standards for security, privacy, uptime, auditability, and customer trust.
Represent the technology function in executive planning, customer conversations, strategic partnerships, and board or investor discussions as needed.

AI Leadership and Governance

AI is already an important part of both our internal development practices and our customer-facing product strategy. This role will be responsible for ensuring that AI is used effectively, securely, and responsibly.

Define the company’s practical AI strategy across internal operations and external product features.
Establish governance for AI-assisted software development, testing, documentation, support, and engineering workflows.
Ensure internal AI tools are used in ways that improve productivity without compromising intellectual property, customer data, security, or code quality.
Lead the architecture and governance of agentic AI features in the company’s SaaS and XR products.
Create standards for AI model selection, prompt management, evaluation, logging, observability, cost management, and human oversight.
Ensure AI-enabled features are designed for reliability, transparency, auditability, and customer trust.
Partner with product leadership to identify high-value AI use cases that solve real customer problems rather than pursuing AI for novelty.
Implement guardrails for privacy, data access, hallucination risk, permissions, workflow automation, and customer-specific data boundaries.
Evaluate vendors, models, frameworks, and AI infrastructure options pragmatically.
Establish internal policies for the safe use of generative AI, agentic workflows, code generation, and customer data.
Help the organization distinguish between experimental AI capabilities and production-grade AI features.

The ideal candidate understands that AI adoption requires more than enthusiasm. It requires governance, testing, security, user experience design, operational monitoring, and clear business value.

People Management

The CTO / VP Engineering will be responsible for developing a strong, accountable, and collaborative engineering culture.
Lead, coach, and mentor software developers, technical leads, QA resources, DevOps/infrastructure personnel, and other technology team members.
Clarify roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and expectations within the engineering organization.
Build career development paths and performance management practices for technical staff.
Hire, onboard, and retain strong engineering talent.
Create a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and practical problem-solving.
Support technical leads and managers in improving estimation, delivery planning, code quality, and team communication.
Identify skills gaps and make recommendations for hiring, training, outsourcing, or team restructuring.
Foster collaboration between engineering, product, customer success, implementation, and support teams.
Encourage high standards without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
Address underperformance directly and constructively.
Promote a low-ego, high-trust environment where people can challenge ideas, improve systems, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Technical Leadership

This role requires enough technical depth to make sound architectural decisions, challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and guide the team through complex product and platform decisions.
Own the technical architecture and long-term scalability of the company’s product platforms.
Provide leadership across SaaS architecture, cloud infrastructure, APIs, integrations, data models, security, reporting, performance, and system reliability.
Guide architectural decisions for multi-tenant SaaS environments, customer-specific configurations, and integration-heavy workflows.
Lead modernization efforts where appropriate, while avoiding unnecessary rewrites or over-engineering.
Establish standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and production readiness.
Ensure systems are maintainable, secure, performant, and cost-effective.
Manage technical debt through clear prioritization and business-aligned trade-off decisions.
Provide technical guidance for the XR development platform, including immersive content workflows, AI-enabled training scenarios, data capture, and platform extensibility.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and vendor/platform choices.
Ensure engineering practices support both innovation and operational stability.

The ideal candidate does not need to be the strongest individual contributor in every technology area, but must be technically credible, architecturally sound, and able to lead senior technical staff effectively.

Product and Customer Partnership

The CTO / VP Engineering will work closely with product, customer success, implementation, and sales teams to ensure that technology supports customer value and business growth.
Partner with product leadership to translate business priorities and customer needs into achievable technical plans.
Help prioritize roadmap items based on customer value, revenue impact, technical complexity, risk, and strategic importance.
Support customer conversations where senior technical credibility is required.
Help evaluate large customer requests, custom development opportunities, integrations, and implementation risks.
Balance the needs of individual customers with the long-term health of the core product.
Ensure technical teams understand the operational realities of unions, trade schools, apprenticeship programs, and skilled trades training environments.
Improve communication between engineering and customer-facing teams.
Help define product capabilities that are scalable, configurable, and repeatable rather than overly customized.
Support go-to-market efforts for AI-enabled and XR-based training capabilities.
Ensure that customer commitments are realistic, well-understood, and aligned with engineering capacity.

Security, Risk, and Compliance

Our customers rely on us to manage sensitive operational, member, training, and organizational data. This role will be responsible for maintaining and improving the company’s security and risk posture.
Establish and maintain security standards across application development, infrastructure, data management, AI usage, and vendor selection.
Ensure appropriate controls are in place for access management, authentication, authorization, data privacy, backups, disaster recovery, and incident response.
Oversee secure software development practices, including code review, dependency management, vulnerability remediation, and penetration testing where appropriate.
Implement governance for the use of customer data in AI systems, analytics, testing, support, and development workflows.
Ensure customer data boundaries are respected across multi-tenant SaaS environments.
Support compliance with contractual, privacy, and security requirements.
Develop policies for data retention, audit logging, administrative access, and production support access.
Maintain practical incident response and business continuity plans.
Communicate clearly with customers and internal stakeholders about security, risk, and technical controls.
Balance appropriate governance with the needs of a growing, pragmatic software company.

Qualifications / Experience

The ideal candidate will have many of the following qualifications:
Prior experience as a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Director of Engineering, or similar senior technology leader.
Experience leading technology teams in a SaaS, product software, or platform company.
Proven ability to manage both strategy and execution in a growing company environment.
Strong understanding of modern software architecture, cloud infrastructure, application security, APIs, data platforms, and DevOps practices.
Experience managing engineering teams through scale, process improvement, modernization, or product growth.
Demonstrated ability to improve delivery predictability, engineering quality, release processes, and team accountability.

Director, Quantitative Data Products

Nasdaq's Alternative Data group specializes in creating unique and insightful data products from non-traditional data sources. Well-known examples of Alternative Data include sentiment measures, real-time tracking of vehicles via GPS transponders, satellite monitoring of industrial facilities, and consumer insights gleaned from anonymized credit card transactions. Our data products empower some of the world's most sophisticated investment funds to outperform.

As Director of Quantitative Data Products, you'll play a critical role in defining strategy and driving execution of a portfolio of innovative Alternative Data products. You'll thrive in this position if you're entrepreneurial, data-driven, and strategic, with a deep understanding of investments and a passion for creating products that generate real business impact in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate has trade floor and/or investments experience, with a strong understanding of buy-side and sell-side trading workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct market research and engage directly with clients to identify new product opportunities and validate concepts.
Own the full product lifecycle from ideation and validation through launch, scale, and ongoing optimization.
Develop and prioritize product roadmaps that align with business objectives and drive measurable revenue growth.
Partner with cross-functional teams including data science, data engineering, partnerships, client success, sales, and marketing to design and deliver innovative data products.
Drive go-to-market strategy, including pricing, positioning, and sales enablement to maximize product adoption and success.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in product management, product development, and/or data analysis within the investment industry.
Deep understanding of capital markets, data product fundamentals, and data feeds/products.
Proven ability to conceptualize and drive new initiatives from 0-to-1 in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and a revenue-focused, owner mindset.
Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong understanding of the alternative data landscape, including key companies and products/services, as well as their competitive positioning.
Experienced in evaluating and applying alternative data to the investment lifecycle (i.e., programming, statistics, backtesting, etc).

new_jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.

The Role

The Managing Director, Technology Architecture & Governance is accountable for setting and governing CPP Investments’ enterprise technology architecture, As Managing Director, Technology Architecture & Governance, you will set and govern CPP Investments’ enterprise technology architecture, engineering practices and lifecycle standards, helping ensure the Fund operates on a resilient, modern and sustainable technology foundation.

Reporting to the Managing Director, Head of Technology & Data, you will provide practical, outcome-focused direction on architecture, technical debt, technology lifecycle management and engineering excellence. This enterprise leadership role has no direct reports and operates through influence, deep technical expertise, sound judgement and effective governance.

The Team

Technology & Data helps enable CPP Investments’ investment strategies and supports the Fund’s day-to-day operations through enterprise technology and data capabilities. Within the department, the Technology Architecture & Governance mandate provides enterprise-wide direction for architecture, engineering practices and technology lifecycle management, partnering across the Fund to strengthen resilience, scalability, cost efficiency and delivery effectiveness.

Accountabilities

Define and maintain the enterprise technology architecture, capability model and capability roadmap aligned to CPP Investments’ mandate, One Fund strategy, and long-term business objectives.
Provide clear architectural direction that balances innovation, resilience, security, and cost efficiency across the enterprise.
Lead lightweight, decision-oriented architecture governance focused on unblocking teams and resolving trade-offs, rather than enforcing rigid controls.
Provide timely, well-reasoned guidance on complex design choices, ensuring alignment across platforms while enabling local autonomy where appropriate.
Act as a senior problem solver for the enterprise, engaging directly in the most complex, ambiguous, and high-impact business problems and technology challenges.
Bring systems thinking and deep technical judgement to diagnose root causes, shape options, and guide decisions that balance near-term outcomes with long-term sustainability.
Own the enterprise approach to technology lifecycle management, including currency, obsolescence, and vendor dependency risk.
Define strategies to identify, prioritize, and systematically reduce technical debt, improving platform stability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership over time.
Set enterprise expectations for software development lifecycle, engineering excellence, and ways of working including agile practices.
Drive continuous improvement in how technology is designed, built, tested, and released, enabling predictable delivery, higher quality outcomes, and faster time to value

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required
Advanced education or professional certifications in architecture, cloud, or engineering practices considered an asset
Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in technology architecture, engineering leadership, or enterprise technology roles
Demonstrated success leading large-scale technology decisions and standards in complex organizations
Experience in financial services, investment management, or other complex enterprises is preferred
Deep expertise in engineering, enterprise architecture, modern technology platforms, and large-scale system design
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, integration patterns, modern data achitecture, and security principles
Proven experience establishing and governing software development lifecycle, engineering standards, and agile practices
Expertise in technology lifecycle management, vendor strategy, and technical debt remediation
Understanding of financial services or large, complex enterprises and their regulatory and risk environments

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.

We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

new_jobs.title: Vice President (Head) of Finance
new_jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected, mission-driven not-for-profit organization dedicated to improving well-being and quality of life in the communities it serves. The organization is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Vice President, Finance to join its Executive Leadership Team. Reporting to the CEO, the Vice President will provide enterprise-wide leadership across Finance and corporate services, while serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and senior leadership team.

The organization delivers essential services to a large and diverse client base. Behind every service are countless financial, operational, and strategic decisions that turn resources into meaningful impact. As Vice President, Finance, the successful candidate will ensure the financial strength, insight, and discipline needed to advance the mission and support long-term sustainability.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an accomplished finance executive who combines strategic insight with operational leadership and wants to influence meaningful outcomes in a purpose-driven organization. More than a functional leader, the Vice President will be a key enterprise partner, helping shape strategy, support growth, and position the organization for continued success in a complex operating environment.

The Mandate

The mandate extends well beyond traditional financial stewardship. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the VP will help shape organizational strategy, support evidence-based decision-making, and ensure the long-term sustainability of an organization delivering critical services.

In partnership with the CEO, Board, and senior leadership team, the VP will provide strategic financial leadership across planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, treasury, audit, risk management, and compliance. They will ensure financial resources are aligned with organizational priorities while maintaining the discipline and accountability the mission requires.

A key priority will be supporting the organization through a period of growth and change. Using financial insights and performance data, the VP will help evaluate opportunities, inform strategic initiatives, and optimize the deployment of resources in a complex funding and operating environment. Success will require balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and sound financial management.

Beyond finance, the VP will provide executive oversight of key corporate services, including procurement and facilities, ensuring effective stewardship of organizational resources and infrastructure. The role will also lead efforts to strengthen internal capabilities, foster collaboration across departments, and build a high-performing, engaged team.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to evolve the finance function from a trusted service provider into an even more proactive strategic partner and to enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. Success will be measured not only by financial outcomes, but also by the ability to influence strategy, support growth, and contribute to long-term sustainability and impact.

Leadership and Stewardship

The organization is seeking a VP Finance who leads with maturity and earns trust through action. This is not a role for someone who relies on title or tenure to get things done. The culture here rewards people who show up prepared, communicate clearly, and follow through.
Operates with humility, credibility, and sound judgment
Brings a practical, solutions-oriented mindset
Communicates clearly and influences at all levels
A good partner to the program managers – asking what they need before explaining what the number say
Leads with integrity, accountability, and transparency

Ideal Background

The successful candidate will bring experience in social services, healthcare, the boarder public sector, or the not-for-profit sector. Those who understand the operational, funding, and stakeholder dynamics of publicly funded organizations will be particular well positioned for success.
A CPA designation and progressive senior finance leadership experience.
Experience leading finance within a complex, multi-stakeholder organization.
A strong understanding of financial planning, financial reporting, treasury, governance, risk management, and internal controls.
Experience working with Boards and senior executives in a strategic advisory capacity.
The ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
A collaborative leadership style and a reputation for building strong relationships across an organization.

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to combine executive-level impact with genuine purpose. As a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Vice President, Finance will help shape decisions that influence the organization’s direction, sustainability, and growth.

The successful candidate will join an organization at an exciting point in its journey, with the opportunity to strengthen financial stewardship, support strategic priorities, and help position the organization for continued success. The organization measures its success not only by financial performance, but by the positive impact it has on the people and communities it serves.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of a mission-driven organization, we encourage you to apply in confidence.

new_jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
new_jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer
Or a VP Engineering who wants to take the next big step

Our client is a growing software company of 20+ people serving the skilled trades and union sector through a portfolio of specialized technology products.

Their business includes three major products:

1. Member Management SaaS Platform

A SaaS product designed for skilled trades unions to manage members, dues, dispatch, communications, reporting, and administrative workflows.

2. Trade School SaaS Platform

A SaaS product focused on apprenticeship and trade school administration, including student records, class scheduling, curriculum tracking, attendance, evaluations, and compliance-related reporting.

3. XR Training and Simulation Platform

An advanced XR development platform that uses virtual reality, mixed reality, motion capture, volumetric video, and agentic AI to create highly detailed, customized training scenarios for the skilled trades. This platform supports immersive, scenario-based learning that can simulate complex work environments, safety procedures, field conditions, and hands-on technical instruction.

Our client’s customers rely on them for dependable systems that support critical operational workflows, member services, education, and training. As they continue to scale, they are looking for a senior technology leader who can bring strategic direction, operational discipline, technical depth, and practical AI leadership to their engineering organization.

Role Summary

We are seeking a CTO / VP Engineering to lead our technology organization through its next stage of growth.

This is a hybrid executive and operational leadership role. The ideal candidate can contribute to company strategy at the leadership table while also driving execution across engineering, architecture, platform reliability, security, AI governance, and product delivery.

This person will be responsible for ensuring that our technology organization is scalable, accountable, secure, and aligned with business priorities. They will help shape the technical vision for our SaaS platforms and XR/AI products while improving delivery predictability, team structure, engineering practices, and long-term product quality.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a mid-sized company where leadership requires both strategic thinking and hands-on operational involvement. They should be able to move fluidly between product strategy, engineering management, customer impact, architecture decisions, AI governance, and team coaching.

Key Responsibilities

Own and evolve the overall technology strategy across the company’s SaaS and XR/AI product portfolio.
Lead the engineering organization, including software development, architecture, infrastructure, DevOps, QA, technical support escalation, and AI-related engineering practices.
Partner with the CEO, product leadership, customer success, sales, and operations to align technology decisions with business goals.
Establish clear engineering priorities, delivery processes, accountability structures, and performance expectations.
Improve predictability of product delivery through better planning, estimation, roadmap execution, release management, and communication.
Balance new product development, customer-specific needs, technical debt, security, scalability, and platform reliability.
Provide technical leadership for multi-tenant SaaS architecture, integrations, data management, reporting, automation, and platform modernization.
Guide the continued development of agentic AI features and immersive XR training capabilities.
Oversee engineering budgets, tooling decisions, vendor relationships, infrastructure costs, and AI-related cost controls.
Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering team.
Define and track engineering performance metrics.
Ensure the company maintains appropriate standards for security, privacy, uptime, auditability, and customer trust.
Represent the technology function in executive planning, customer conversations, strategic partnerships, and board or investor discussions as needed.

AI Leadership and Governance

AI is already an important part of both our internal development practices and our customer-facing product strategy. This role will be responsible for ensuring that AI is used effectively, securely, and responsibly.

Define the company’s practical AI strategy across internal operations and external product features.
Establish governance for AI-assisted software development, testing, documentation, support, and engineering workflows.
Ensure internal AI tools are used in ways that improve productivity without compromising intellectual property, customer data, security, or code quality.
Lead the architecture and governance of agentic AI features in the company’s SaaS and XR products.
Create standards for AI model selection, prompt management, evaluation, logging, observability, cost management, and human oversight.
Ensure AI-enabled features are designed for reliability, transparency, auditability, and customer trust.
Partner with product leadership to identify high-value AI use cases that solve real customer problems rather than pursuing AI for novelty.
Implement guardrails for privacy, data access, hallucination risk, permissions, workflow automation, and customer-specific data boundaries.
Evaluate vendors, models, frameworks, and AI infrastructure options pragmatically.
Establish internal policies for the safe use of generative AI, agentic workflows, code generation, and customer data.
Help the organization distinguish between experimental AI capabilities and production-grade AI features.

The ideal candidate understands that AI adoption requires more than enthusiasm. It requires governance, testing, security, user experience design, operational monitoring, and clear business value.

People Management

The CTO / VP Engineering will be responsible for developing a strong, accountable, and collaborative engineering culture.
Lead, coach, and mentor software developers, technical leads, QA resources, DevOps/infrastructure personnel, and other technology team members.
Clarify roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and expectations within the engineering organization.
Build career development paths and performance management practices for technical staff.
Hire, onboard, and retain strong engineering talent.
Create a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and practical problem-solving.
Support technical leads and managers in improving estimation, delivery planning, code quality, and team communication.
Identify skills gaps and make recommendations for hiring, training, outsourcing, or team restructuring.
Foster collaboration between engineering, product, customer success, implementation, and support teams.
Encourage high standards without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
Address underperformance directly and constructively.
Promote a low-ego, high-trust environment where people can challenge ideas, improve systems, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Technical Leadership

This role requires enough technical depth to make sound architectural decisions, challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and guide the team through complex product and platform decisions.
Own the technical architecture and long-term scalability of the company’s product platforms.
Provide leadership across SaaS architecture, cloud infrastructure, APIs, integrations, data models, security, reporting, performance, and system reliability.
Guide architectural decisions for multi-tenant SaaS environments, customer-specific configurations, and integration-heavy workflows.
Lead modernization efforts where appropriate, while avoiding unnecessary rewrites or over-engineering.
Establish standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and production readiness.
Ensure systems are maintainable, secure, performant, and cost-effective.
Manage technical debt through clear prioritization and business-aligned trade-off decisions.
Provide technical guidance for the XR development platform, including immersive content workflows, AI-enabled training scenarios, data capture, and platform extensibility.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and vendor/platform choices.
Ensure engineering practices support both innovation and operational stability.

The ideal candidate does not need to be the strongest individual contributor in every technology area, but must be technically credible, architecturally sound, and able to lead senior technical staff effectively.

Product and Customer Partnership

The CTO / VP Engineering will work closely with product, customer success, implementation, and sales teams to ensure that technology supports customer value and business growth.
Partner with product leadership to translate business priorities and customer needs into achievable technical plans.
Help prioritize roadmap items based on customer value, revenue impact, technical complexity, risk, and strategic importance.
Support customer conversations where senior technical credibility is required.
Help evaluate large customer requests, custom development opportunities, integrations, and implementation risks.
Balance the needs of individual customers with the long-term health of the core product.
Ensure technical teams understand the operational realities of unions, trade schools, apprenticeship programs, and skilled trades training environments.
Improve communication between engineering and customer-facing teams.

Establish and maintain security standards across application development, infrastructure, data management, AI usage, and vendor selection.
Ensure appropriate controls are in place for access management, authentication, authorization, data privacy, backups, disaster recovery, and incident response.
Oversee secure software development practices, including code review, dependency management, vulnerability remediation, and penetration testing where appropriate.
Implement governance for the use of customer data in AI systems, analytics, testing, support, and development workflows.
Ensure customer data boundaries are respected across multi-tenant SaaS environments.
Support compliance with contractual, privacy, and security requirements.
Develop policies for data retention, audit logging, administrative access, and production support access.
Maintain practical incident response and business continuity plans.
Communicate clearly with customers and internal stakeholders about security, risk, and technical controls.
Balance appropriate governance with the needs of a growing, pragmatic software company.

Prior experience as a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Director of Engineering, or similar senior technology leader.
Experience leading technology teams in a SaaS, product software, or platform company.
Proven ability to manage both strategy and execution in a growing company environment.
